description: A test suite for the ConnectionManager class, testing TLS parameter resolution, gateway host recognition, and node connection options in an Android environment using Robolectric.

classes.name: ConnectionManagerTest
classes.description: Test class for ConnectionManager functionalities, including TLS params resolution, host recognition, and connection options building.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_prefersStoredPinOverAdvertisedFingerprint
methods.description: Tests that the TLS parameters resolve correctly when a stored fingerprint is present, prioritizing stored over advertised.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_doesNotTrustAdvertisedFingerprintWhenNoStoredPin
methods.description: Ensures that no trust is assigned when no stored pin exists despite an advertised fingerprint.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_manualRespectsManualTlsToggle
methods.description: Verifies manual TLS toggle respects user settings.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_manualNonLoopbackForcesTlsWhenToggleIsOff
methods.description: Checks that non-loopback manual endpoints enforce TLS when manual toggle is off.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_manualPrivateLanCanStayCleartextWhenToggleIsOff
methods.description: Ensures private LAN endpoints remain cleartext if manual toggle is off.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryTailnetWithoutHintsStillRequiresTls
methods.description: Confirms that discovery endpoints without hints still require TLS.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryPrivateLanWithoutHintsCanStayCleartext
methods.description: Ensures private LAN without hints can remain cleartext.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryLoopbackWithoutHintsCanStayCleartext
methods.description: Confirms loopback addresses without hints are permissible without TLS.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryLocalhostWithoutHintsCanStayCleartext
methods.description: Ensures localhost addresses without hints can remain cleartext.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryAndroidEmulatorWithoutHintsCanStayCleartext
methods.description: Verifies emulator network addresses without hints stay cleartext.

methods.name: isLoopbackGatewayHost_onlyTreatsEmulatorBridgeAsLocalWhenAllowed
methods.description: Tests correct handling of emulator bridge IP based on configuration.

methods.name: isPrivateLanGatewayHost_acceptsLanHostsButRejectsTailnetHosts
methods.description: Differentiates LAN hosts from tailnet hosts for gateway purposes.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryIpv6LoopbackWithoutHintsCanStayCleartext
methods.description: Verifies IPv6 loopback addresses can remain cleartext without hints.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryMappedIpv4LoopbackWithoutHintsCanStayCleartext
methods.description: Verifies IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses on localhost remain cleartext.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryNonLoopbackIpv6WithoutHintsRequiresTls
methods.description: Confirms non-loopback IPv6 addresses require TLS.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryUnspecifiedIpv4WithoutHintsRequiresTls
methods.description: Confirms unspecified IPv4 addresses require TLS.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint_discoveryUnspecifiedIpv6WithoutHintsRequiresTls
methods.description: Confirms unspecified IPv6 addresses require TLS.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_advertisesRequestableSmsSearchWithoutSmsCapability
methods.description: Checks command and capability advertisement when SMS search is enabled without SMS capability.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_doesNotAdvertiseSmsWhenSearchIsImpossible
methods.description: Verifies SMS commands are not advertised when search is disabled.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_advertisesSmsCapabilityWhenReadSmsIsAvailable
methods.description: Checks advertisement of SMS capabilities when read SMS is available.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_advertisesSmsSendWithoutSearchWhenOnlySendIsAvailable
methods.description: Verifies only Send SMS command is advertised when only send is available.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_advertisesAvailableNonSmsCommandsAndCapabilities
methods.description: Verifies multiple command and capability advertisements based on device features.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_omitsVoiceWakeWithoutMicrophonePermission
methods.description: Ensures Voice Wake capability is not advertised if no microphone permission.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_omitsUnavailableCameraLocationAndCallLogSurfaces
methods.description: Checks that unavailable features are not advertised.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_advertisesOnlyAvailableMotionCommand
methods.description: Verifies only available motion commands are advertised.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions_omitsMotionSurfaceWhenMotionApisUnavailable
methods.description: Ensures motion commands are omitted when APIs are unavailable.

methods.name: newManager
methods.description: Creates a test-configured instance of ConnectionManager with mock capabilities for testing different options.
